name: Cuyahoga Rolling Mill
description: The furnaces are cold. The compliance lights are not.

interactions.label: Question the remaining shift
interactions.description: Someone still punches the clock here.

interactions.label: Salvage the idle line
interactions.description: Recover useful metal without becoming part of the inventory.
interactions.result: A dead control cabinet yields wiring and a circuit board. The mill records the loss as efficiency.

interactions.label: Use the fabrication bench
interactions.description: Heavy tools, heavier licensing requirements.

interactions.label: Inspect the smokestack cameras
interactions.description: Review installation contracts and active units.

interactions.label: Walk the restricted floor
interactions.description: Invite an industrial patrol to notice you.

name: Lake Erie Freight Arcade
description: Cargo changes hands beneath departure boards that list only delays.

interactions.label: Approach the freight counter
interactions.description: Forms, rumors, and freight classifications are available.

interactions.label: Open the freight market
interactions.description: Trade goods on Cleveland's regional exchange.

interactions.label: Read the freight notices
interactions.description: Read or leave short posts for other Cleveland players.

interactions.label: Inspect freight manifests
interactions.description: Look for cargo the Agencies mislabeled deliberately.
interactions.result: Three manifests disagree about the same sealed crate. The disagreement is useful.

interactions.label: Retain an unofficial courier
interactions.description: Pay someone who knows which checkpoints are decorative.
interactions.result: The courier accepts five credits and gives you a timetable printed before the route existed.

name: Memorial Park Service Tunnel
description: A maintenance corridor runs beneath the duck pond. Hoofprints continue into the concrete.

interactions.label: Speak with the park regulars
interactions.description: The groundskeeper, the mascot, and the Cyberhorse are present.

interactions.label: Count the pigeons
interactions.description: Count all of them, including the ones that do not eat.
interactions.result: The count changes whenever you write it down. You keep the least impossible number.

interactions.label: Dredge beneath the grate
interactions.description: Reach into municipal water with institutional confidence.
interactions.result: You recover a wet lens and decide not to ask what it saw.

interactions.label: Inspect wildlife monitoring
interactions.description: The ducks have a surveillance ledger.

interactions.label: Enter goose territory
interactions.description: Challenge whatever currently controls the pond.

name: Sector 4 Motor Pool
description: White installation vans idle beneath a sign reading COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIP.

interactions.label: Report to the motor-pool office
interactions.description: Foreman Ray and executive supervision are available.

interactions.label: Review installation contracts
interactions.description: Take wages, make coverage, ask no questions.

interactions.label: Use the electrical bench
interactions.description: The tools are company property until they disappear.

interactions.label: Search the installation vans
interactions.description: Look for the paperwork that vanished from Ray's timesheets.
interactions.result: A permit sits beneath a coil of cable. Its signature predates the form.

interactions.label: Infiltrate dispatch
interactions.description: Listen to the crews before the routes are published.

name: Cul-de-Sac Heights South
description: Every lawn is compliant. Every doorbell has an opinion.

interactions.label: Visit Boomer Hank
interactions.description: He has notes from the last neighborhood-watch meeting.

interactions.label: Use the HOA notice board
interactions.description: Read or leave short posts for other Atlanta players.

interactions.label: Attend neighborhood watch
interactions.description: Sit visibly and become less interesting for a while.
interactions.result: The minutes list you as PRESENT, COOPERATIVE, and POORLY HYDRATED.

interactions.label: Browse the sanctioned garage sale
interactions.description: Trade goods beneath the HOA's watchful bunting.

interactions.label: Tail the HOA patrol
interactions.description: Learn who reports whom and in what order.

name: Peachtree Broadcast Roof
description: A citywide information mast hums above a rooftop garden nobody waters.

interactions.label: Meet the rooftop contacts
interactions.description: Peaches and Lil Peep-Peep are comparing frequencies.

interactions.label: Hijack the information display
interactions.description: Replace one approved sentence with another.
interactions.result: For eleven seconds, every sign reads THE BIRDS HAVE SUPERVISORS.

interactions.label: Intercept headquarters traffic
interactions.description: The tower broadcasts confidence without encryption.

interactions.label: Inspect the rooftop relay
interactions.description: Review high-exposure cameras and their contracts.

interactions.label: Cross the security line
interactions.description: Invite communications security to object.

name: Storm Drain Outfall 9
description: The water goes out. The listening equipment faces inward.

interactions.label: Speak beneath the outfall
interactions.description: Vern and Saltine both insist they arrived first.

interactions.label: Search the runoff traps
interactions.description: Recover electronics filtered from the city's mistakes.
interactions.result: The trap contains wiring, a circuit board, and one municipal apology.

interactions.label: Tap the buried communications
interactions.description: Follow a cable that does not appear on city plans.

interactions.label: Inspect flood monitoring
interactions.description: Review cameras trained on the wrong side of the levee.

interactions.label: Enter the service culvert
interactions.description: Meet inspectors, wildlife, or both.

name: The Shrimp Net Chapel
description: Votive lights glow behind nets repaired with surveillance wire.

interactions.label: Speak with Odette Marchand
interactions.description: Her murals contain more serial numbers than saints.

interactions.label: Read the parish notices
interactions.description: Read or leave short posts for other New Orleans players.

interactions.label: Leave a small offering
interactions.description: Pay for the privilege of looking harmless.
interactions.result: A candle is lit in your name, then filed under an alias.

interactions.label: Use the net-mending bench
interactions.description: Craft tools from wire, knots, and regulatory ambiguity.

interactions.label: Examine the chapel murals
interactions.description: Trace recurring shapes that resemble camera routes.
interactions.result: The painted halos align with three unlisted relay sites.

name: Catfish Acres
description: Houseboats and trailers share one address and several radio frequencies.

interactions.label: Visit the residents
interactions.description: Boomer Earl and Shrimpcaster LaRue are holding court.

interactions.label: Search the abandoned sheds
interactions.description: Look for marine hardware with terrestrial applications.
interactions.result: A corroded housing comes loose after only one tetanus-related thought.

interactions.label: Inspect neighborhood cameras
interactions.description: Review mailbox units and subsidized installations.

interactions.label: Attend the fish fry
interactions.description: Eat publicly. Suspicious people rarely bring napkins.
interactions.result: You leave fed, documented, and temporarily ordinary.

interactions.label: Monitor the watch radio
interactions.description: Listen for your own description.

name: Municipal Visitor Center
description: Coffee, maps, and compulsory orientation are served from the same counter.

interactions.label: Speak with Barista-Inspector Cole
interactions.description: Order a stamp, a coffee, or an explanation.

interactions.label: Use the visitor bulletin board
interactions.description: Read or leave short posts for other Seattle players.

interactions.label: Request an official stamp
interactions.description: Present paperwork with confidence exceeding its validity.
interactions.result: Cole stamps the document without reading it. Professional courtesy is alive.

interactions.label: Search lost and found
interactions.description: Inspect objects the city has classified as unclaimed.
interactions.result: You claim a pair of binoculars last seen watching their owner.

interactions.label: Buy inspection coffee
interactions.description: The receipt certifies that you were somewhere ordinary.
interactions.result: The coffee is severe. Your paper trail is comforting.

name: Cascade Rainworks
description: Stormwater is measured, redirected, and asked to accept the privacy policy.

interactions.label: Consult Harbor Engineer Priya
interactions.description: She knows which pipes carry water and which carry data.

interactions.label: Search the collection grates
interactions.description: Recover raw material before Public Works inventories it.
interactions.result: A grate yields wiring and a lens polished by municipal rain.

interactions.label: Use the maintenance bench
interactions.description: Craft beneath a diagram labeled FLOW OF RESPONSIBILITY.

interactions.label: Inspect watershed cameras
interactions.description: Review installations that allegedly watch salmon.

interactions.label: Audit environmental reports
interactions.description: Compare public rainfall with classified rainfall.

name: Evergreen Switchyard
description: Freight cars disappear into mist and reappear with better paperwork.

interactions.label: Meet Moss
interactions.description: Courier work is available to people who did not ask.

interactions.label: Search an idle freight car
interactions.description: Recover something before its destination is invented.
interactions.result: A crate marked MOSS CONTROL contains a useful circuit board.

interactions.label: Intercept rail dispatch
interactions.description: Listen for trains that officially never arrived.

interactions.label: Cross the active tracks
interactions.description: Risk a patrol in the rain.

interactions.label: Study the stowaway route
interactions.description: Learn the inexpensive way out of Seattle.
interactions.result: Moss marks a route in disappearing ink. You memorize it before policy changes.

name: Office of Zoning Compliance
description: Every window is smart glass. None of it trusts you.

interactions.label: Approach Clerk Miriam
interactions.description: Request permits, denials, and denials of prior denials.

interactions.label: Use the civic-feedback terminal
interactions.description: Read or leave short posts for other Silicon Valley players.

interactions.label: Apply for a camera variance
interactions.description: Ask permission to place what is already there.
interactions.result: Your variance is approved retroactively and denied prospectively.

interactions.label: Search public ownership records
interactions.description: Discover which shell company owns the public sidewalk.

interactions.label: Submit contradictory forms
interactions.description: Overwhelm your file with mutually exclusive compliance.
interactions.result: The system cannot classify you without admitting an error. It chooses delay.

name: Perpetual Motion Capital Lobby
description: The valuation rises every time the revolving door completes a turn.

interactions.label: Speak with the lobby regulars
interactions.description: Brad and Boomer Greg are between liquidity events.

interactions.label: Review market projections
interactions.description: Trade using charts that become accurate after publication.

interactions.label: Enter a volatile short-term scheme
interactions.description: Invest ten credits in a company with no present tense.
interactions.result: The position exits itself. You receive twelve credits and a founder's apology thread.

interactions.label: Tail the founders
interactions.description: Follow the fleece vests toward undisclosed material information.

interactions.label: Enter the partner corridor
interactions.description: Test how private the private market is.

name: E-Waste Reclamation Campus
description: Yesterday's future is sorted into profitable bins.

interactions.label: Speak with the perimeter staff
interactions.description: Ping and Groundskeeper Walt know what the campus discards.

interactions.label: Salvage discarded electronics
interactions.description: Recover components before the recycling ledger does.
interactions.result: A prototype becomes two circuit boards and several nondisclosure obligations.

interactions.label: Use the precision workbench
interactions.description: Craft with tools calibrated to investor expectations.

interactions.label: Inspect inventory cameras
interactions.description: Review automated installations and takedown opportunities.

interactions.label: Enter the autonomous yard
interactions.description: Challenge a security system still in public beta.

name: Subway Platform B
description: No train is scheduled. Everyone is waiting anyway.

interactions.label: Speak with Raymond
interactions.description: He knows where lost objects go before Lost Property does.

interactions.label: Search beneath the benches
interactions.description: Recover what commuters abandoned deliberately.
interactions.result: A lens rolls from beneath a bench. It is warm and recently interested.

interactions.label: Tail a transit officer
interactions.description: Follow the person pretending not to watch the platform.

interactions.label: Inspect platform surveillance
interactions.description: Review cameras with excellent views of delays.

interactions.label: Enter the service passage
interactions.description: Risk a patrol or a transit-specific inconvenience.

name: Port Authority Lost Property Office
description: Everything arrives here eventually, including explanations.

interactions.label: Question the office regulars
interactions.description: Sable and Marin Voss are evaluating unclaimed culture.

interactions.label: Read the public notices
interactions.description: Read or leave short posts for other New York City players.

interactions.label: Browse the property auction
interactions.description: Trade items whose owners failed to complete Form L-0ST.

interactions.label: File a speculative claim
interactions.description: Describe an object vaguely enough to satisfy policy.
interactions.result: The clerk gives you a survey tripod and asks you to leave before ownership clarifies.

interactions.label: Examine interstate records
interactions.description: Trace packages that crossed state lines without moving.

name: Midtown Rooftop Relay
description: The skyline blinks in protocols tourists cannot see.

interactions.label: Consult Chad Brennan
interactions.description: He prices surveillance as an emerging asset class.

interactions.label: Inspect the rooftop relay
interactions.description: Review high-value camera contracts and active units.

interactions.label: Intercept encrypted traffic
interactions.description: Listen to the part of the city that never sleeps because it is polling.

interactions.label: Deploy a borrowed jammer
interactions.description: Create one brief and expensive blind spot.
interactions.result: The relay misses seven seconds and files all seven as suspicious weather.

interactions.label: Cross the response perimeter
interactions.description: Invite Midtown surveillance response to introduce itself.
